package com.bookworm.reader;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;

/** Reader typography is independent of Milestone 002's unchanged interface preferences. */
public final class ReaderPreferences {
    public boolean paged, serif;
    public int size, margin, spacing;
    public static ReaderPreferences load(Context context) {
        SharedPreferences p = context.getSharedPreferences("reading", Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        ReaderPreferences r = new ReaderPreferences();
        r.paged = p.getBoolean("paged", false); r.serif = p.getBoolean("serif", true);
        r.size = Math.max(14, Math.min(32, p.getInt("size", 20)));
        r.margin = Math.max(8, Math.min(40, p.getInt("margin", 20)));
        r.spacing = Math.max(12, Math.min(22, p.getInt("spacing", 16))); return r;
    }
    public boolean save(Context context) {
        return context.getSharedPreferences("reading", Context.MODE_PRIVATE).edit().putBoolean("paged", paged)
                .putBoolean("serif", serif).putInt("size", size).putInt("margin", margin).putInt("spacing", spacing).commit();
    }
    public String css(ThemeSettings theme) {
        return " html,body{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;background:" + ThemeSettings.hex(theme.background)
                + "!important;color:" + ThemeSettings.hex(theme.text) + "!important;}"
                + "body{font-family:" + (serif ? "serif" : "sans-serif") + "!important;font-size:" + size + "px!important;line-height:" + spacing / 10.0 + "!important;}"
                + "*{color:inherit!important;background:transparent!important;max-width:100%!important;word-wrap:break-word;}"
                + "a{color:" + ThemeSettings.hex(theme.accent) + "!important;}"
                + "#bw-content{box-sizing:border-box;padding:" + margin + "px;}img{max-width:100%!important;height:auto!important;max-height:80vh!important;}"
                + "pre{white-space:pre-wrap!important;word-wrap:break-word;}table{table-layout:fixed;width:100%;}p,li{orphans:1;widows:1;}";
    }
}
